claims.claim: Nikon z fc is a retro-inspired, slr-style mirrorless camera featuring a 20.9-megapixel APS-C sensor.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a Nikon camera body and lens, but the exact model (Z fc) and any sensor/megapixel details are not readable; no model number or EXIF/specs are shown.

risks.risk: Exact camera model may not be Z fc (could be another Nikon body), which changes value.
risks.proof: A clear shot of the model name/number on the camera body (e.g., the label showing Z fc) and/or the menu “About” screen showing model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Nikon mirrorless/unknown Nikon body with lens, worst-case for model uncertainty.

risks.risk: Lens model/condition is unknown; different lenses vary widely in value and performance.
risks.proof: A close, readable photo of the lens front ring/side label showing the lens model/part number (e.g., DX/VR/kit lens markings).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unspecified kit/standard lens with unknown optical condition.

risks.risk: Functional status is unknown (shutter, autofocus, metering, flash).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the camera powering on, focusing on a subject, taking a photo, and reviewing the image on the screen (plus flash test if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/unknown working condition.

risks.risk: Sensor and lens optics may have dust, fungus, haze, scratches, or oil—photos don’t confirm.
risks.proof: A test shot of a blank white wall at high f-stop (e.g., f/16) and a close photo of the lens elements under light to check for fungus/haze.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing cleaning/with possible optical wear.

risks.risk: Battery health and completeness are unknown; battery pack shown but capacity/health not verified.
risks.proof: A clip showing battery level after charging and a full power-on test; also a photo of battery model/label and charger (if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming average/unknown battery health and no guarantee of long runtime.

risks.risk: Memory card inclusion/capacity and whether it’s working are unknown.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the memory card label (capacity/brand) and a clip showing the camera recognizing it and saving a photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming card may be non-working or low value/unknown capacity.

risks.risk: Accessories completeness is unknown (charger, cables, strap, caps, original box).
risks.proof: A full spread photo of everything included (charger, USB cable, strap, manuals, all caps) with labels visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal included accessories (only what’s shown).

risks.risk: Ports/contacts and covers may be missing or damaged (affects usability and resale).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all ports (USB/HDMI/memory slot) and battery compartment contacts/door.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if ports/covers may be incomplete or worn.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the exact camera model name/number on the body (confirm Z fc).
Clear photo of the lens model/part number markings (confirm lens type).
Video: power on → autofocus on a subject → take a photo → playback on screen.
Test image of a blank white wall at high f-stop to check sensor dust/scratches.
Close photos of lens elements under light to check fungus/haze/oil.
Photo of battery label and a clip showing battery level after powering on and shooting.
Photo of memory card label (capacity/brand) and a clip showing the camera recognizes it and saves an image.
Full accessories spread showing charger/cables/strap and all caps included.
response.reason: The witness confirms it’s a Nikon camera with a lens and some accessories, but the exact model (Z fc) and lens identity/condition and working status are not verifiable from the provided shots. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
